constraints.definition: CHECK ((((latitude IS NULL) AND (longitude IS NULL)) OR ((latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (longitude IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.name: ck_tb_evento_corridas_radar_coordinate_pair

constraints.definition: CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90.0'::numeric)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90.0)::double precision))))
constraints.name: ck_tb_evento_corridas_radar_latitude

constraints.definition: CHECK (((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180.0'::numeric)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180.0)::double precision))))
constraints.name: ck_tb_evento_corridas_radar_longitude
